README.md:
# app_projects service

Set DATABASE_URL to an isolated PostgreSQL URL with the postgresql+psycopg scheme.
The application does not use a local database fallback.

1. Run uv sync.
2. Run uv run alembic upgrade head.
3. Run uv run uvicorn app_projects.app:app.
4. Open /docs for the API or /healthz for a database connection check.

Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a separate PostgreSQL database before running
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
Run uv run alembic downgrade base to undo the migration.
alembic/env.py:
from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

from app_projects.database import database_url
from app_projects.models import Base


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata)
            with context.begin_transaction():
                context.run_migrations()
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

import os
from collections.abc import Iterator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def database_url() -> str:
    value = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "")
    if not value.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
        raise RuntimeError("DATABASE_URL must be a postgresql+psycopg URL")
    return value


engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with Session(engine) as session:
        yield session

from datetime import date, datetime
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self


class ProjectCreate(BoundedInput):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    name: str
    description: str | None = None
    note: str | None = None


class ProjectRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    name: str
    description: str | None
    note: str | None
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime


class ProjectPatch(BoundedInput):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    name: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    note: str | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def reject_null_for_required_columns(self) -> "ProjectPatch":
        nullable = {
            "name": False,
            "description": True,
            "note": True,
        }
        for field in self.model_fields_set:
            if getattr(self, field) is None and not nullable[field]:
                raise ValueError(f"{field} cannot be null")
        return self


class TodoCreate(BoundedInput):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    title: str
    description: str | None = None
    completed: bool = False
    due_on: date | None = None
    counter: int | None = None


class TodoRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    project_id: int
    title: str
    description: str | None
    completed: bool
    due_on: date | None
    counter: int | None
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime


class TodoPatch(BoundedInput):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    title: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    completed: bool | None = None
    due_on: date | None = None
    counter: int | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def reject_null_for_required_columns(self) -> "TodoPatch":
        nullable = {
            "title": False,
            "description": True,
            "completed": False,
            "due_on": True,
            "counter": True,
        }
        for field in self.model_fields_set:
            if getattr(self, field) is None and not nullable[field]:
                raise ValueError(f"{field} cannot be null")
        return self


class BatchCreate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    parent: ProjectCreate
    children: list[TodoCreate] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)


class BatchRead(BaseModel):
    parent: ProjectRead
    children: list[TodoRead]

Set DATABASE_URL to an isolated PostgreSQL URL with the postgresql+psycopg scheme.
The application does not use a local database fallback.

1. Run uv sync.
2. Run uv run alembic upgrade head.
3. Run uv run uvicorn app_projects.app:app.
4. Open /docs for the API or /healthz for a database connection check.

Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a separate PostgreSQL database before running
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
Run uv run alembic downgrade base to undo the migration.

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_projects.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "extra_4": 3,
            "extra_0": 3,
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "title": "sample",
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "extra_0": 3,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/api/projects", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/api/projects" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/todos"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["project_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/projects" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"project_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")

from app_catalogs.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "code": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "sku": "sample",
            "name": "sample",
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/catalogs", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/catalogs" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/products"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["catalog_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/catalogs" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"catalog_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_catalogs.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "extra_0": 3,
            "name": "sample",
            "extra_4": 3,
            "code": "sample",
            "extra_2": 1.5,
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "extra_0": 3,
            "sku": "sample",
            "name": "sample",
            "extra_2": 1.5,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/api/catalogs", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/api/catalogs" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/products"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["catalog_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/catalogs" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"catalog_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_collections.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "url": "sample",
            "title": "sample",
            "rank": 3,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/collections", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/collections" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/bookmarks"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["collection_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/collections" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"collection_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

1. Run uv sync.
2. Run uv run alembic upgrade head.
3. Run uv run uvicorn app_collections.app:app.
4. Open /docs for the API or /healthz for a database connection check.

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

from app_collections.database import database_url
from app_collections.models import Base


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata)
            with context.begin_transaction():
                context.run_migrations()
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self

    servings: int | None = None
    note: str | None = None

        nullable = {
            "name": False,

from app_recipes.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "servings": 3,
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "quantity": 1.5,
            "unit": "sample",
            "rank": 3,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/recipes", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/recipes" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/ingredients"
            try:

                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["recipe_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/recipes" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)

        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,

        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()

    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)

    finally:

from datetime import date, datetime
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self


class CustomerCreate(BoundedInput):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    name: str
    reference: str
    note: str | None = None

    reference: str | None = None

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_customers.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "reference": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "external_code": "sample",
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/customers", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/customers" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/contacts"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["customer_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/customers" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"customer_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from app_customers.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "reference": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "name": "sample",
            "rank": 3,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/customers", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/customers" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/contacts"

                self.assertEqual(client.post("/customers" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)

from alembic import context

from app_customers.database import database_url

def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata)
            with context.begin_transaction():
                context.run_migrations()
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_devices.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "serial": "sample",
            "name": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "summary": "sample",
            "passed": True,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/devices", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/devices" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/inspections"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["device_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/devices" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"device_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    serial: str
    name: str
    note: str | None = None

    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    serial: str | None = None
    name: str | None = None
    note: str | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def reject_null_for_required_columns(self) -> "DevicePatch":
        nullable = {
            "serial": False,
            "name": False,
            "note": True,
        }
        for field in self.model_fields_set:

        return self

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_devices.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "serial": "sample",
            "extra_0": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "name": "sample",
            "extra_4": 3,
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "summary": "sample",
            "extra_0": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "passed": True,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/api/devices", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/api/devices" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/inspections"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["device_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/devices" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"device_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

README.md:
# app_surveys service

Set DATABASE_URL to an isolated PostgreSQL URL with the postgresql+psycopg scheme.
The application does not use a local database fallback.

1. Run uv sync.
2. Run uv run alembic upgrade head.
3. Run uv run uvicorn app_surveys.app:app.
4. Open /docs for the API or /healthz for a database connection check.

Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a separate PostgreSQL database before running
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
Run uv run alembic downgrade base to undo the migration.
alembic/env.py:
from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

from app_surveys.database import database_url
from app_surveys.models import Base


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata)
            with context.begin_transaction():
                context.run_migrations()
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

import os
from collections.abc import Iterator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def database_url() -> str:
    value = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "")
    if not value.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
        raise RuntimeError("DATABASE_URL must be a postgresql+psycopg URL")
    return value


engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with Session(engine) as session:
        yield session

        for name in self.model_fields_set:

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_surveys.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "extra_4": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "extra_0": 3,
            "title": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "text": "sample",
            "extra_0": 3,
            "extra_4": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/api/surveys", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/api/surveys" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/questions"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["survey_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/surveys" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"survey_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")

from app_courses.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "code": "sample",
            "title": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "title": "sample",
            "minutes": 3,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/courses", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/courses" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/lessons"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["course_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/courses" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self

    code: str
    title: str
    note: str | None = None

    created_at: datetime

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    code: str | None = None
    title: str | None = None
    note: str | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def reject_null_for_required_columns(self) -> "CoursePatch":
        nullable = {
            "code": False,
            "title": False,
            "note": True,
        }
        for field in self.model_fields_set:

class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_experiments.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "extra_4": 3,
            "code": "sample",
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "extra_0": 3,
            "title": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "sample_count": 3,
            "value": 1.5,
            "extra_0": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/api/experiments", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/api/experiments" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/observations"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["experiment_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/experiments" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"experiment_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    finally:

    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")

from app_documents.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "reference": "sample",
            "title": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "reviewer": "sample",
            "external_code": "sample",
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/documents", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/documents" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/reviews"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["document_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/documents" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"document_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)

                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def database_url() -> str:
    value = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "")
    if not value.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
        raise RuntimeError("DATABASE_URL must be a postgresql+psycopg URL")
    return value

def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with Session(engine) as session:

class BoundedInput(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bounded_values(self):
        for name in self.model_fields_set:
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 255:
                raise ValueError("strings must have at most 255 characters")
            if type(value) is int and not -(2**31) <= value < 2**31:
                raise ValueError("integers must fit signed 32 bits")
        return self

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_url = os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")
if not test_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
    raise RuntimeError("TEST_DATABASE_URL must name an isolated PostgreSQL database")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = test_url

from app_documents.app import app


def parent_payload():
    return {
            "extra_4": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "title": "sample",
            "extra_0": 3,
            "reference": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "extra_0": 3,
            "extra_2": 1.5,
            "reviewer": "sample",
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            parent = client.post("/api/documents", json=parent_payload())
            self.assertEqual(parent.status_code, 201, parent.text)
            path = "/api/documents" + "/" + str(parent.json()["id"])
            children = path + "/reviews"
            try:
                child = client.post(children, json=child_payload())
                self.assertEqual(child.status_code, 201, child.text)
                self.assertEqual(child.json()["document_id"], parent.json()["id"])
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 409)
                self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/documents" + "/with-children", json={"parent": parent_payload(), "children": []}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.patch(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"]), json={"document_id": 999}).status_code, 422)
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(children + "/" + str(child.json()["id"])).status_code, 204)
            finally:
                self.assertEqual(client.delete(path).status_code, 204)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
